cohort: The study included 98 newborns, comprising 23 full-term and 75 preterm infants, from whom oral swabs were collected.
finding: Preterm newborns exhibit delayed and less diverse oral microbiome development compared to full-term newborns, with persistent dominance of Proteobacteria and enrichment of virulence-related genes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to reduce oral microbiome diversity in preterm newborns.
birth_weight: Varied among full-term and preterm newborns, measured as an influencing factor.
